summary: A stale catalog version blocks the retinol caution even though both IDs are in version 3.

findings.explanation: example-retinol was stored with catalog version 1. The active catalog is version 3, so its IDs were not used as matches.
findings.reason: catalogVersion does not equal the catalog version passed to the engine.
limitations: Team-approved v1 rules. This is not clinically validated or a safety guarantee. Severity, when present, is display priority and not a clinical grade.
